title: EventBus different instance selective unregister contract

contract.instance_selective_unregister: unregister() removes only the bound method belonging to the specified target instance
contract.same_function_different_target: Callbacks sharing the same __func__ remain distinguishable by their __self__ target
contract.callback_isolation: Removing handler_a.callback does not remove handler_b.callback
contract.post_unregister_delivery: The removed handler receives no subsequent events
contract.remaining_callback_delivery: The remaining handler continues receiving events
contract.registry_stability: Selective instance removal leaves the remaining listener structurally consistent
contract.permission_enforcement: Unregister and emit continue to require the events permission
